items.note: Clarksons Denmark hired a one-year full-time Shipbroker Intern for 2026 (now filled), and a 2027 version is likely this winter. Your placement at Clarksons Copenhagen is your best lever here, so ask your contact there now when it opens.

The flagship route to becoming a Clarksons broker. Last round, London closed 16 Feb 2026 and other offices stayed open longer. Two years with first-year rotations; Oslo had its own 2026 listing. Checked 16 Oct: the programme page still says only that the 2026 intake is closed.

Clarksons is opening an office in Monaco (dry cargo, tankers, gas, S&P and more) and invites interest across experience levels. Reposted 14 Oct 2026. Monaco is outside the EU/EEA, so ask careers@clarksons.com whether they would hire a junior and handle the Monaco work permit.
Two openings: one supporting the container team, one the bulk/tanker team. Deadline confirmed on MB's own job list.
Open through their job portal, currently listed with an end date of 31 Dec 2026 (it is renewed each year). Useful for flagging interest in the 2027 trainee intake early.

Trainee places listed as open in all offices, including Copenhagen, Bergen, Kristiansand, Hamburg and Geneva. Send CV and cover letter to recruitment@howerob.com quoting reference TR20 and name the office you want.
Letter, CV, transcripts and references to career@fearnleys.com.
General open application on their careers page. They also run summer intern places in Bergen.

items.start: Flexible; Academy trainees start every September
items.note: Their 2026/2027 Academy round is closed, but they take unsolicited applications at applications@lightshipchartering.com.
12-month shipbroking programme. The 2026 round closed 31 January 2026.
12-month programme. The 2026 round (August start) was posted on finn.no and closed 21 January 2026. The finn.no feed in the widget picks up the new ad.
Previous London and Singapore rounds closed 1 March. Oslo and Geneva dates are not published, so ask career@fearnleys.com now.
Recruits in March-April. Two years with the Danish Shipping Academy, then a permanent job.
12-month programme rotating through offices and departments. Closed now with no 2027 dates, so also send an unsolicited CV through the page.
Desk-based trainee scheme. Opening date is an estimate: the 2024 and 2026 rounds opened on 1 and 9 February, and the September 2026 intake is now closed. Name Oslo or Hamburg when you apply.
Product tanker owner. Student assistants (15-20 h/week) are hired as departments need them; set up TORM's job agent to be told first.

items.role: Shipping Talent Pipeline (internships, trainee and graduate roles)
items.note: Dry bulk operator with a large chartering desk. This is an open invitation to be considered for internships, trainee roles and graduate jobs across their offices, with no deadline. Join it now so you are on their list before roles are posted.

Chartering and freight trading desk of one of the largest charterers. The 2026 intake started in June and its posting has now been taken down; 2027 dates are not published yet, so search Cargill careers for 'Ocean Transportation Academy'.
Dry bulk and tankers. Previous rounds closed 16 March and 27 April 2025. Includes the Danish Shipping Academy.
Tankers. Two-year programme with the Danish Shipping Academy.

Applications open now. Commodity trader with its own shipping arm (Clearlake Shipping). Degree must be finished by June 2027. The page gives no closing date and says decisions are made by year end; last year's window closed 31 October, so apply this week.

Shipowner and ship manager. Deadline 25 Oct confirmed on the NHHS job board; starts 14 June 2027 at the Lysaker head office. Project in weeks 24-26 and 30-32. Students graduating in 2028 are prioritised, so stress your interest in staying on. Apply through Wilhelmsen's Workday page.
